info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Management Manual Submission API
info.description: The Management Manual Submission API enables businesses to upload and manage knowledge assets related to their operations. This functionality is crucial for maintaining up-to-date documentation, ensuring compliance, and optimizing workflow within an organization. Typically used by compliance officers, operations managers, and knowledge managers, this API provides an efficient way to submit and retrieve management manuals. By utilizing this endpoint, teams can enhance their operational efficiency and knowledge sharing.
